svg.aria-label: Espressionism import boundaries. Packages: the client and the api are entry points; the client may use any package but reaches the agent only through its contract, and the api uses only the agent. The agent uses the calculator and the store, which never import each other, and both use tool, a leaf. Inside the client: routes, then shell components, then domain features (calculator, store, chat), then base features (mascot, theme, common, webmcp), then ui primitives and lib, each importing only the layers below. Nothing imports a route, only routes mount pages, and a feature keeps its stores private.
svg.text: Arrows point the only way imports may go. pnpm lint:boundaries checks it in CI.
Nothing imports a route; features use getRouteApi
Site and hero headers: compose features
A feature's pages/ are mounted by routes only
Never use a domain feature; stores/ stay private
shadcn primitives and helpers; no app code
